title: Scotland's Education Agency Published Purportedly AI-Edited School Curriculum Papers with Apparently Nonexistent References
summary: Education Scotland, the national education agency, published evidence papers for Scotland's school curriculum review. A University of Edinburgh lecturer identified about 20 references he believed did not exist. The agency corrected errors and disclosed that AI was used to edit the papers. Whether AI introduced any of the disputed references remains unconfirmed.
